description: Start a chat with an agent (list_agents) and wait for the answer. `agent` is the agent's id, name or role key (ceo, cto, creative…). In a one-assistant workspace the assistant does every kind of work: a role key that names no agent there (creative, qa…) reaches the assistant, and the result says so in `routed`. Beside the Studio, pass `production` (a video id) so the Creative Director (or the assistant) sees that video. The reply's `actions` are proposals (a task, media to make, a card): apply one with apply_chat_action. `wait_seconds` (default 90, max 300) is how long to wait for the reply.

company.description: the company id (list_companies); not needed when you have one company, asked for otherwise

name: ask_agent
title: Ask an agent
